**Sprint 2 Plan \- ArrowBerry rev. 1**

4/6/2026 \- 4/20/2026

 **Goal: Finish implementation of all the features that are core to our system, meaning that we will have an MVP following the completion of this sprint.**

∙ **Task listing, organized by user story:** This section lists the user stories, in priority order from  most important (top) to least important (bottom). Within each user story, there needs to be a  list of tasks required to implement the user story, along with the time estimate for each tasks (preferably less than or equal to 6 ideal hours). This should look like: 

**\[user story 1\]** As a forgetful person, I would like a ‘digital pantry’ page where all the ingredients I have can be visualized, so that I can be aware of what I have while I am not in my kitchen/pantry

	**\[task 1\]** Read a users ingredients from database

	**\[task 2\]** Put those ingredients into user friendly visualization

	**\[task 3\]** Create buttons to edit, add, or delete entries

**\[user story 2\]** As a person who likes eating variety, I would like a well populated and diverse selection of recipes to choose from, so that I don’t have to repeat recipes

	**\[task 1\]** Create web scraper to grab recipes off of various sites

	**\[task 2\]** Optimize so we only scrape necessary parts of the page (ingredients, instructions)

**\[Task 3\]** Normalize all the data into a way we can easily work with (CSV/JSON format)

**\[Task 4\]** Write the recipes to the database

**\[user story 3\]** As a user, I want to be able to refine my recommendations so that I can make a recipe more catered towards me. 

	**\[task 1\]** Create search bar feature in discover page

	**\[task 2\]** Create buttons for specific types of food, (Mexican, Italian, Chinese, etc)

**\[user story 4\]** As a user I would like to save my favorite recipes to my profile so that I can quickly access them at any time

	**\[task 1\]** Add save to profile button on recipe modal

	**\[task 2\]** Add saved recipes section to profile page

	**\[task 3\]** Implement feature so that saved recipes are clickable buttons that redirect you to the original recipe

	**\[task 4\]** Created the saved recipes database, and reference the uuid of the user who wants to save that recipe
